name: Texas Youth Range Workshop
org: Texas Section, Society for Range Management
what_you_do: High school students spend a week at the Texas Tech University Center in Junction. They learn about grassland, plants, soil and wildlife on Texas ranches.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 14 to 18 from across Texas.
pay_detail: Program fee not stated on the page. Organizers say they can help applicants find sponsors.
deadline_text: 2026 workshop was June 21 to 26, 2026. The 2026 deadline and 2027 dates were not posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application linked from the workshop website. Questions: tssrmyrw@gmail.com.
notes: Check the site for the 2027 application. Sponsor contacts: Dorian Damerau 830-387-8429 or Jr. Tompkins 979-541-3411.
